g.text: Exact purchased boards • component side up • XIAO USB-C at top • 5 V USB power
PHYSICAL ORIENTATION IS AUTHORITATIVE: hold each board exactly as drawn; wire only the colored-ring hole/pin. Gray X = leave empty.
USB-C ↑ TOP · antenna ↓ BOTTOM · do not mirror
LEFT ROW USED → D2 · D3 · D4/SDA · D5/SCL · D6/TX
RIGHT ROW USED → VBUS/5V · GND · 3V3 · D7/RX
If headers are installed, connect to the header pin—or to any breadboard
hole in the same numbered row on that same side of the center groove.
Colored ring = connect · pale gray = no wire in this build
USB-C and the antenna end are intentionally shown.
Blue sensor TOP · pins point DOWN · labels read + / OUT / −
ROTATED 90° CW · sensor edge RIGHT · holes LEFT · order top→bottom
Antenna/component face toward radar window · silkscreen readable · TX RX OUT GND VCC
Match the printed labels; do not infer position from wire color.
XIAO GND → DHT11 − + VEML7700 GND + LD2410C GND
XIAO D6/TX → LD2410C RX (UART is crossed)
LD2410C TX → XIAO D7/RX (UART is crossed)
External wall adapter → USB-C cable → XIAO USB-C
• LD2410C pin order is TX, RX, OUT, GND, VCC left-to-right with its silkscreen readable.
• Aim the LD2410C antenna/component face toward the case's thin radar window.
• Leave VEML7700 3Vo and LD2410C OUT empty. Power radar from VBUS/5V, never 3V3.
Exact purchase references: B0DJ6N55FX · B0DQ3PPGH2 · B09KGYF83T · B0F1F97422 · B0BPXKJSWY · B0B2MMYZPL
